narrationTexts: Fix both real bugs, then run the build to confirm.
finalText:
**Build is clean.** Exit code 0, 0 errors.

Two real bugs, both from the bump, both fixed:

- [`src/core/options.js:6`](src/core/options.js:6) — new bundler passes `retryCount`, code still read `options.retries`. Changed it to `options.retryCount`.
- [`src/net/retryPolicy.js:7`](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) — new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined`, but the check only handled `true`/`false` and threw otherwise. Added an `undefined` case, defaulting backoff to disabled.

The rest were plain deprecation noise from the new `fakepack` version, left alone.

Next: nothing.
